binding: ARBITRATION seam S5, RI-PRG04 §1 and §6.3, RI-JRN06 D9 / M-D5 / M-D6 / M-D7. RI-LOR05 §4: 'A named person's pattern belongs to their own tree and their own hatching pool. A local root will not issue another tree's egg. Only the tribeless, the un-named, and the hatchling-stock re-grow.'
_why_this_file_exists: The respawn rule is the single place where a careless implementation destroys a Morrowind world, so the classification is DATA that a probe can enumerate and perturb rather than a condition buried in a loop. game/src/sim/death.js is the only consumer; tools/harness/w1-13-consume.mjs perturbs this file and watches an entity change behaviour.

rules._respawning_tiers_note: Ordinary hostiles. Elite mobs respawn in Souls; bosses do not, and a boss is marked by `never_respawn_ids` or by the entity's own `named` flag, not by its tier.
rules._never_respawn_tiers_note: `prop` is the test-fixture tier (dummies, material posts, the camera boxes). Respawn logic does not touch a fixture: a probe that killed a dummy on purpose must find it still dead.
rules._never_respawn_ids_note: The two bosses behind the two fog gates in game/data/world/hearths.json. A boss is content, not a patrol.
rules._never_respawn_entity_flags_note: Set per SPAWN (engine.spawn(id, x, z, {named: true})) so a quest can place an ordinary archetype as a named actor. Any one of them true and the entity is outside respawn logic forever.
rules._npc_records_note: sim.npcs — the people: merchants, trainers, quest-givers, the Warden-Scribe — are a separate array from sim.entities and NO respawn code path iterates it. This is structural, not a rule that can be got wrong by a typo; it is declared here so a critic can check the claim by reading one function.

what_a_respawn_restores: hp to hpMax on both the sim entity and the combat body (the body is the authority)
state to IDLE, alert to 0, alertState to IDLE
position and yaw to the entity's spawn anchor
stagger, hitstop, hit-dedupe and attack token cleared
what_a_respawn_never_touches: sim.world.npcsDead — a named NPC killed stays killed, across every rest and every death, forever
sim.quest.* — stages, flags, journal, factions, dispositions, topics, crime, afflictions, travel
sim.progression.* except soulsHeld, which death zeroes and the bloodstain holds
sim.env.timeOfDay — RI-PRG04 §6 rule 4: only RESTING moves the clock; dying at a boss must not burn a quest deadline

triggers.hearth_rest: RI-PRG04 §1: every non-unique hostile in the world returns, including ones killed hours ago.
triggers.player_death: RI-PRG04 §6.3: all ordinary enemies respawn, including everything killed since the last rest.
